actualBoundary.firstError: Error: Timed out waiting for saved prompt acknowledgement visible before Save

lastStep.step: select the fixture team and review its saved one-time startup prompt

exactSelectionChain: SchedulesView.handleCreate sets editingSchedule=null and dialogOpen=true; create dialog receives editingSchedule?.teamName, so the source create path does not pass the currently open org-team tab as a teamName prop.

LaunchTeamDialog starts selectedTeamName at the empty string. Its team options sort teamByName values by teamName; value=teamName, label=displayName||teamName, description=description||undefined. Effective identity is propsTeamName||selectedTeamName.

Creation driver first clicks the first role=combobox button inside any role=dialog, without an exact listbox/control identity. The team control occurs before SmartScheduleFields in the current dialog source; the actual selector match count is unretained.

The item expression searches every document [cmdk-item], accepts textContent.includes(full fixture team name), and takes the first match. It does not join the opened trigger aria-controls/listbox ID, check exact option value, assert one matching item, or retain the matched element identity.

CdpClient.click first waits for truthiness of that expression, then separately evaluates it again, scrolls the selected element, and reads one center point. It sends original mousePressed and mouseReleased to that point. It does not record the actual hit target or selected option, or assert selectedTeamName after the click.

Combobox renders each item from one option keyed/value-bound by option.value. The non-disabled onSelect closure synchronously calls onValueChange(option.value), then closes and clears search. LaunchTeamDialog directly stores that name. No mapping from the selected fixture value to org-team was found.

The only other setSelectedTeamName write in LaunchTeamDialog resets it to an empty string. The saved-prompt hook reads the effective selected identity and writes only its separate review state; it cannot select org-team.

Saved-prompt display additionally requires task-first mode, a current same-team review and a nonempty resolved saved prompt. Missing/failed/currentness-cancelled request may leave the acknowledgement absent. No specific request result or branch is retained in this failure.

selectorContractFinding.finding: The test selector is not an exact identity predicate: allowed label/description text and prefix-sharing names can satisfy it for a different value; global first-match selection also does not prove uniqueness or the intended open listbox.

finiteSourceReasoningOnly.deduction: With this allowed rendered ordering, textContent.includes(target) would accept the first option, while its onSelect would correctly deliver another-team. This is a source counterexample to selector identity, not observed DOM, a test execution, or evidence that the retained org-team had such text.

selectorContractFinding.knownFixtureLimits: The seeded fixture description is the fixed Disposable Teams creation E2E fixture. The earlier copied-description check and applied-template description do not contain the full UUID team name. The org-team label itself differs and does not contain it. The archive retains only screenshots, not the complete current team catalog/option DOM or matched option value, so a particular duplicate/substring match is not established.

whatIsNotEstablished: No deterministic product onSelect/state mapping defect is demonstrated.
No actual duplicate option, wrong selector match, hidden listbox, displayName alias, option reorder, keyboard selection or pointer retarget is retained.
Popover source permits portal placement and open/close animation; this is not evidence that animation or layout caused this failure.
A returned CDP press/release command does not identify its DOM recipient or certify a specific React state transition.
The later org-team image does not distinguish selection of org-team at dispatch from a subsequent change; no duration or sequence is inferred.
The original 45-second wait, 80ms delay and 30-second CDP command bound remain unchanged; extending or retrying them is not a selected remedy.
E2 mac success on the same seven reviewed leaves is a separate original outcome, not a repair proof or qualification transfer to E3.
minimumMissingEvidence: The identity/value and listbox ownership of the actual item selected by the original click, plus the first post-click selected-team observation, are missing. Any future observation/acceptance change would require a separately reviewed bounded R1 preserving original actions and budgets; none is proposed or applied here.
disposition: No repair selected. Preserve the concrete selector-identity weakness separately from the unknown cause of actual org-team selection and saved-prompt timeout.
